title: A Weird Al-themed language joins Hack-&-Build
summary:
Two community coding projects joined the lists, while model names and pricing metadata got a correction.

YankoviC was added to the project list. Its Accordion IDE uses Pollinations for tab autocomplete and chat assistance while people learn the language.

PairFusion was added to the Vibe Coding project list, with links to its demo and repository. It offers an AI-assisted collaborative IDE for real-time pair programming and feedback.

The model list now identifies `openai` as GPT-4o Mini and `openai-audio` as GPT-4o Mini Audio Preview. Pricing metadata was also revised across several listed models.
